log_level.description: Charon daemon debug logging level. Format: 'layer subsystem level' (e.g., '2 0,2 0,2 0,2 0' for default minimal verbosity). See strongSwan docs for levels.

unique_ids.description: Whether to enforce unique IDs for IKE_SAs (prevents duplicate connections from same ID).

connections.description: List of IPsec connections to configure. Each entry defines one tunnel or transport connection.

type.description: Connection type: 'tunnel' (IPsec between subnets), 'transport' (end-to-end host traffic).

esp.description: ESP (encapsulating security payload) proposal(s) for child SAs, as list of cipher-auth-DH strings.

ike.description: IKE (Internet Key Exchange) proposal(s) for IKE SAs, as list of cipher-auth-DH strings.

type.description: How to identify the left endpoint: 'host' (fixed IP/FQDN), '%any' (accept any), '%defaultroute' (from default route).

value.description: If type='host', the IP address or hostname of the local endpoint.

id.description: Local identity (e.g., hostname or certificate subject).

subnet.description: Local subnets to protect behind this connection (e.g., ['10.0.0.0/24']).

cert.description: Local certificate file (in /etc/ipsec.d/certs/) for pubkey auth.

private_key.description: Local private key file path (in /etc/ipsec.d/private/) — sets leftfirewall=yes.

type.description: How to identify the right endpoint: 'host' (fixed IP/FQDN), '%any', '%defaultroute'.

value.description: If type='host', the IP address or hostname of the remote endpoint.

subnet.description: Remote subnets to protect behind this connection.

certificate.description: Remote CA or end-entity certificate name (in /etc/ipsec.d/certs/).

life_seconds.description: Child SA lifetime in seconds (e.g., 3600 for 1 hour).

life_kb.description: Child SA lifetime in kilobytes (e.g., 1000000 for ~1 GB).

auto.description: Startup behavior: 'start' (auto-connect on startup), 'add', 'route' (only install policy).

pfs_group.description: Diffie-Hellman group for Perfect Forward Secrecy (e.g., 'modp2048', 'modp4096', or '' for default).

comments.description: Optional per-connection comments to preserve in config.
